risk_reasons: Changes the worker's solicitation batch eligibility and durable ask/refusal outcomes.
Adds tenant-scoped reads of attribution evidence and changes owner-facing coverage claims.
goal: Make solicitation restraint and its owner-facing coverage claims reflect recorded evidence, resolving GitHub issues 1076, 1077, and 1048.
non_goals: No spontaneous reviewer name matching or cross-location identity matching.
No schema migration, activation timestamp, historical refusal backfill, or remote flag change.
No changes to withhold precedence, the six reason codes, or refusal category mappings.
No commit, push, deployment, merge, or GitHub issue mutation without authorization.
user_visible_behavior: 1076: retain a disclosure that automatic-policy holds were not recorded while automatic posting was off, including after it is enabled. Without an activation history, this conditional historical disclaimer does not expire automatically.
1077: explicitly disclose incomplete archival history when the bounded archival-event read omits older events; preserve the separate full refusal count and entry truncation disclosure.

1048: withhold a contact when earlier outreach at the same location has confirmed attribution to an extant review with a recorded review date. Use all retained attribution history, without applying the 14-day attribution or display windows again.
1048: persist the real review ID/date on the ask evidence and the existing ask_withheld/already_reviewed/wrong_moment Refusal on its run when the ledger is enabled.
1048: replace coming-soon copy with a qualified statement about reviews linked to earlier requests at this location, explicitly avoiding a never-ask-again promise.
invariants: Refusal decisions and run outcomes remain atomic with batch construction; retries remain idempotent.
Consent and suppression retain precedence over already_reviewed; sentiment and rating never influence eligibility.
Every evidence lookup is scoped to the owning account, location, and bounded candidate IDs.
Missing or deleted review evidence and missing review dates are not replaced with invented IDs or dates.
The single refusal writer, ledger kill switch, outbox ownership, and existing lock ordering remain unchanged.
Archived-period reads stay bounded and retain newest-first selection; owner responses expose no raw refusal codes, moderation prose, or contact PII.
edge_cases: Automatic posting on/off, empty and populated windows, account/location views, all selectable window sizes.
Exactly the archival-event limit versus limit plus one, a leading unpaired reactivation, and an omitted period intersecting the selected window.
A contact with attributed outreach older than the attribution display window is still withheld when dated review evidence survives.
Unattributed outreach, deleted linked review, null review date, sibling-location attribution, and another tenant's attribution do not create a matched review.
Multiple attributable reviews select one deterministically; consent/suppression still win; a replay produces no duplicate ask or refusal.
The ledger disabled path still withholds the ask without writing a Refusal.
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/lib/refusals/read.ts: getRefusalLog and its bounded reads.
src/lib/solicitation/batch-builder.ts: loadCandidateWindow, prior-send bulk lookup, toCandidate, atomic ask/refusal persistence.
src/lib/solicitation/attribution.ts: retained outreach attribution joined to reviews.
CONTEXT.md: Coverage start, Withhold reason, Attribution match; ADR 0023 owner-safe projection.
test_seams: getRefusalLog through its live-database integration suite.
RestraintReport rendering and RestraintContent payload validation.
buildSolicitationBatch through its live-database integration suite, observing asks, evidence, runs, refusals, and replay results.
Requests UI rendering and local end-to-end browser journeys.
tests_to_add: discloses historical policy-hold gaps after automatic posting is enabled
discloses archival truncation only when more than the event limit exists
qualifies archived periods when an older in-window period was omitted
rejects a malformed archival truncation field
withholds an attributed reviewer and records dated evidence plus one refusal on replay
uses retained attribution beyond the attribution display window
does not match attributed reviews from another account or sibling location
does not fabricate evidence for a deleted review or missing review date
preserves consent and suppression precedence for an attributed reviewer
withholds an attributed reviewer while the refusal ledger is disabled
rollback_plan: Revert this change through the normal deployment process after separate authorization; existing immutable asks and refusals remain historical facts. No remote migration or flag rollback is needed.
observability: Batch reason counts show already_reviewed; stored evidence identifies its review and date; the run has the corresponding refusal when recording is enabled.
The Restraint tab visibly qualifies historical policy gaps and bounded archival history.
